decision: As KerML 8.2.4.3.1 states it: `chains`, then either an OwnedFeatureChaining or a FeatureChain. The Xtext fragment is identical. Neither alternative is defined in this clause, so whether they can overlap is for their own units to establish. FeatureDeclaration repeats FeatureRelationshipPart, so a feature may carry more than one ChainingPart, and the corpus has exactly that.

evidence.note: `feature obPiP chains objectToFinish.beforePaint.isPainted = false;`, a dotted chain
`feature b_f_a chains b chains f.a;`, two ChainingParts, the first a single name and the second a dotted chain
fragment ChainingPart: 'chains' ( ownedRelationship += OwnedFeatureChaining | FeatureChain ). Agrees.

notes: re-scoped (ADR-0015): only the kerml grammar reaches this production, so its work now lives in ChainingPart@kerml
